definitions.explanation: The person who plans and leads a criminal act, conspiracy, or organized wrongdoing. The one behind the scheme.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mastermind of the incident was arrested.

examples.japanese: {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ringleader has not yet been identified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}っている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The police are pursuing the mastermind of the fraud ring.

notes: Composed of ⟦{首謀|しゅぼう}→首謀：22551_shubou⟧ (plotting, scheming) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Almost always carries a negative connotation — the person behind illegal or harmful activities. Common collocations: {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to arrest the ringleader), {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧ (to identify the mastermind). Compare with ⟦{黒幕|くろまく}→黒幕：15478_kuromaku⟧ (puppet master — someone pulling strings from behind the scenes) and ⟦{主犯|しゅはん}→主犯：18011_shuhan⟧ (principal offender — the legal term).
